name: VVV CL002 (Hubble)
blurb: VVV CL002, a globular cluster near the center of the Milky Way, seen by Hubble.
label: vvvcl002-hubble
story: Of all the Milky Way's known globular clusters, this one lies closest to the Galactic center. It travels on a counterrotating orbit, a survivor of the fierce tides near the Galaxy's heart.

claims.text: VVV CL002 is the known Galactic globular cluster closest to the Galactic center
VVV CL002 has a counterrotating orbit
VVV CL002 is a survivor of the Galaxy's tidal forces near the center
VVV-CL002 is a Hubble Missing Globular Clusters Survey target imaged in the infrared
